text: i see. its data store across the board. i am finding [store unavailable: data store: corrupt record at cart/hmsc-int/data/streams/sessions.jsonl:884] we need to move to pg or sqlite which are in the framework already
resolution: STOREDB-0606 complete in three commits. Step 0 (c6f8565fc): the reader now honors the tolerance law — a corrupt/partial record anywhere in a stream is skipped, logged loudly, and quarantined in memory (store.quarantine()); the fold continues with every valid record and the file is never rewritten; the store came back immediately with all good records (897 sessions records folded, :884 quarantined). Forensics with the bytes: line 884 = 48 torn bytes of seq 896 (an interrupted whole-file write) with a complete seq-4077 record spliced on 18.2h later by the next append's read-concat-write (no newline guard); two concurrent instances confirmed separately — line 884's spliced record and line 885 both carry seq 4077, 2ms apart, different workbench session ids. Step 1a (e694aa488): __sql_* extracted from the telemetry ingredient into its own sqlite ingredient (v8_bindings_sqlite.zig), registered in tools/v8cli so the P4 suites can reach sqlite; the has-telemetry piggyback retired in both ship paths. Step 1b (d95877cdd): streams moved to ONE sqlite DB (data/store.db, WAL + BEGIN IMMEDIATE; global seq allocated inside the write lock) behind the unchanged openStore() door — V20 semantics survive exactly (append-only INSERT-only table, per-concern stream column, undo points as seqs, snapshots untouched, schema evolution by addition). Byte-faithful tail-incremental ingest imported all 6 archive streams (1428 records, :884 quarantined, originals untouched as the archive). Concurrency proven by a P4 test spawning two real v8cli writer processes: 300/300 appends land, zero duplicate seqs, strict total order. sqlite chosen over pg: in-process, no daemon, dlopen'd libsqlite3, WAL gives exactly the single-writer transaction semantics needed; pg's embedded server is the wrong weight for a local editor store. data.test.ts 15/15; game verify 57/58 (the one RED is the paint lane's uncommitted brush-kinds drift, not store-related).
